verdict.rationale: Driver openness is a fair question for a discrete GPU, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions open-source kernel modules, upstream Linux drivers, or Linux support of any kind. The CUDA toolkit items cover libraries, compilers and Windows on Arm support, which is adjacent material and not an open-driver capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run this GPU on an open driver — open-source kernel modules or upstream Linux support documented by the vendor
